title: ADR-0155 step 1 (spec): the share-grant semi-join leaf — brand, factory and guard, comparand door option, conformance cases, ISharingService / ISecurityService prose
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvvVzM5KhCWkT5f45c

Filing gate: ④ an execution card of an accepted cross-layer ADR · Source: fleet (ADR-0155, accepted in PR #34735, merge 64ccf6b0, ruling 6942854600; its Execution plan says the seats cut the cards in order). Part of #33787.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：一个成员在同一对象上被共享超过 5000 条后，多出来的共享静默失效（#33787）。ADR-0155 已定修法：把共享读改成库内子查询，分 6 步落地，这是第 1 步。
- 这一步做什么：只在 spec 里加「共享授权子查询叶子」这一契约件和说明文字，不改运行时行为。
- 不做会怎样：后面引擎、驱动、plugin-sharing 几步都没有契约可依，#33787 修不了。
- 要你做的：无。

## Why (business)
Inherits #33787: customers with large sharing volumes (team-shared account lists, rule-based bulk shares) silently lose access past 5,000 grants per member per object, and #33683's one-row-per-rule shares make that come sooner. ADR-0155 is the accepted fix; this card is its first step and every later step reads the contract it adds.

## Scope (ADR-0155 Execution plan, step 1, verbatim intent)
- The brand, its factory and guard beside `ReadableIds` (`packages/spec`).
- The comparand door's option; the fixed inner read's description.
- The conformance case-set.
- The `ISharingService` and `ISecurityService` prose, including: a narrowing of reads of `sys_record_share` registered for that table by name is never read around and gets the second class's answer as ② is ruled (R1 at boot, with the seam's refusal behind it); a narrowing that names no object is not run on the share arm from the switch on (D4's boundary). The shared pieces take the two-leaf shape (D4).
- ⛔ No runtime behaviour change and no boot refusal on this card (plan step 5: "No card up to here refuses a boot").
- The card declares its own `Clause-②:` and runs its own gates (plan intro). Governing text: `docs/adr/0155-sharing-scope-share-grants-lower-to-an-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf.md` (Decision D1–D6, Execution plan step 1).

## Order
Step 1 of 6. Later steps are cut by the seat as each one becomes current (rolling): 2 engine seam → 3 driver-sql + Turso remote → 4 driver-memory → 5 census rest → 6 plugin-sharing switch, which is #33787 itself and lands last, after O8's census is recorded in its body.

## Reader
Seat `repo:objectstack#7`, a dedicated card thread (L program, `packages/spec/**`; area-lease 〈不入区〉 for the program). L1 by `L1-a`; contract (L2) review per `contract-review.md`.

## Dedupe
`"ADR-0155" is:issue` → #33787 (the defect), #33877 (on hold), #33899 and #34102 (closed). No execution card exists.

Grade: p2 — a blocker card takes the highest grade of the open cards it blocks (#33787, p2). Type: Task.
